scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Hm...after several days of observation, this place seems to be a device imprinted with the memories of an airship.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
嗯……经过几天的观察，这个地方似乎是一个刻有飞空艇记忆的装置。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
...that is different. I don't have any more information...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 雷恩]
……情况有些不同。我没有更多的信息了……

scripts.text: ^ff0000Memorial Dungeon cannot be reentered within 23 hours after your last entrance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000距离上次进入记忆地下城不足23小时，无法再次进入。^000000

scripts.translation: ^ff0000等级低于125级的玩家无法进入此地下城^000000

scripts.translation: ^ff0000进入地下城需要创建或加入至少1名成员的队伍。^000000

scripts.translation: ^ff0000此记忆地下城仅限1人进入。只有队伍首领可以进入。^000000

scripts.translation: 强化装置

scripts.text: Use the Device
scripts.translation: 使用装置

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: ^ff0000This Memorial Dungeon is only for 1 person. Only the party leader can enter.^000000

^ff0000click to enter again.^000000

^ff0000次元装置形成后^000000
^ff0000点击再次进入。^000000

scripts.translation: ^ff0000进入地下城需要创建或加入至少1名成员的队伍。^000000

scripts.translation: ^ff0000队伍首领尚未使用装置。^000000

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
...Glad there aren't any of those pesky things here...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
……还好这里没有那些讨厌的家伙……

scripts.text:
[Loki]
...I will defend this place no matter what. Go down into the airship...!!
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
……无论如何，我都会守护这个地方。去飞空艇的下面……！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Flying in the air through with the strength of machinery... the development of technology is truly marvelous.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
凭借机械的力量在空中飞行……科技的发展真是令人惊叹。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
But I feel there's a power of some kind... I think this airship won't be able to fly solely just by technology.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
但我感觉到有一种力量……我觉得这艘飞空艇不可能仅靠科技就能飞行。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I will face them here. Chaos, go down to the lower floor of the airship with Iris!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
我会在这里迎战。混沌，和艾莉丝一起下到飞空艇的下一层！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Whoa~ this is great!! The wind is so cool~!!
Hooray~ we are flying through the sky! For free on top of that!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
哇~太棒了！！风好凉爽~！！
万岁~我们在天空中飞翔！而且还是免费的！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Is it not marvelous how this huge ship can fly without the use of magic? Chaos?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
这艘巨大的船不用魔法就能飞，是不是很神奇？混沌？

scripts.text:
[Iris]
...?? Chaos?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
……？？混沌？

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
.....Sage Kadmon..
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
……贤者 卡德蒙……

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What are you doing instead of listening to me!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
你居然不听我说话！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Argh! Aaah~!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
啊！啊啊~！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Humph! That's what you get for being absent-minded!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
哼！活该，谁让你走神了！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Ah...Iris!! Are you trying to kill me~!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
啊……艾莉丝！！你想杀了我吗~！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Humph! I don't care if you die or not...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
哼！你死不死我才不在乎……

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Hey!! No horsing around on the ship!!
This is what's wrong with young humans. They have no manners! If you act up I will toss all of you off!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
喂！！在船上不许打闹！！
这就是你们这些年轻人类的问题。一点礼貌都没有！再闹我就把你们全部扔下去！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Oops... By the way captain, how does this big airship fly through the sky? It is so marvelous!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
哎呀……对了船长，这艘巨大的飞空艇是怎么在天空中飞行的呢？真是太神奇了！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Huh? That's a good question.
As you can see, we heat the large boiler to boil water then use the pressure of the steam to move the pistons which turns the cogwheel and moves the turbine to turn the propeller.
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
嗯？问得好。
正如你所见，我们加热巨大的锅炉把水烧开，利用蒸汽的压力推动活塞，带动齿轮转动涡轮，从而驱动螺旋桨。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Eh... So that's how this big ship floats... but now the feeling of the mystery is gone. I thought there would be some mystical device... a little disappointed...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
原来……这艘大船是这样漂浮的……不过现在神秘感全没了。我还以为会有什么神秘装置呢……有点失望……

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
That's right. This big ship can't be in the sky with just steam. So it uses an amplifier called a 'Rune Engine'.
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
没错。光靠蒸汽，这艘大船是飞不上天的。所以它使用了一种叫做“符文引擎”的增幅器。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Rune Engine? What is that?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
符文引擎？那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
It's a device that uses a magical stone.
Something about fallen fragments of a broken heart according to the legends... a ridiculous legend but that doesn't matter...
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
它是一种利用轮回之石碎片的装置。
传说那是破碎之心的碎片……虽然是个荒谬的传说，但这并不重要……

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
The stone is the so-called 'Tear of Ymir.' If put in junction with locomotive engines like steam engines, the rune exuded from the stone amplifies the energy.
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
这种石头被称为“尤弥尔的泪滴”。如果与蒸汽机之类的动力引擎结合，石头散发出的符文会放大能量。

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
In all honesty it is not an overstatement to say a rock the size of a thumb is moving this ship. It possesses an incredible power.
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
说实话，说这块拇指大小的石头在驱动这艘船，一点也不夸张。它拥有不可思议的力量。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
That little thing...!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
就这么一小块……！！！

scripts.text:
[Loki]
......huh?
Something is coming this way...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
……嗯？
有什么东西正朝这边过来……

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Alert!! Alert!! A large Wyvern unit at 7 o'clock!!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
警报！！警报！！7点钟方向发现大量双足飞龙！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
What?!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
什么？！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Gre...Gremlins!! Gremlins have landed from the Wyvern!!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
小……小鬼！！小鬼从双足飞龙上降落了！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Hm... What is this now?
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
嗯……这是什么情况？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Hahahaha~ You have waited long!!
Beautiful sorceress Arcana's surprise airborne monster show!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
哈哈哈哈~ 你们等很久了吧！！
美丽的魔女阿尔卡纳的空中魔物表演秀！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Wha...what show?
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
什……什么表演？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Now... Let us get started! Gremlins~!!
It's PARTY TIME~!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
好了……让我们开始吧！小鬼们~！！
派对时间到~！！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Cap..Captain! This is serious!
Gremlins are all over the ship!!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
船……船长！情况很严重！
小鬼们已经遍布整艘飞空艇了！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
What?! These are Gremlins?!
You bastards!! Come down from there now!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
什么？！这些是小鬼？！
你们这群混蛋！！快从上面下来！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Captain. There is no need to be so agitated.
Gremlins are just monsters that tinker with machines. Rather...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
船长。不必如此激动。
小鬼只是喜欢捣鼓机器的魔物。而且……

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
You don't know what you're talking about!!
We're at an altitude of 8000!! Even a minor malfunction could lead to a deadly crash!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
你根本不懂！！
我们现在在8000米的高空！！哪怕是一点小小的故障都可能导致坠机！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Argh!! Rear engine number 1!!
...This is serious! They are heading towards the engine room! We have to protect the Rune Engine!!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
啊！！1号后引擎！！
……情况很严重！它们正朝引擎室冲去！我们必须保护符文引擎！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Damn it... Where did I put my weapon...
Hey humans!! Block that nuisance while I go to the captain's room to look for my weapon!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
该死……我把武器放哪了……
喂，人类！！你们先挡住这些麻烦的家伙，我去船长室找武器！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
We have to especially stop them from getting to the Rune Engine!! If that is destroyed the ship can no longer fly!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
我们必须特别阻止它们接近符文引擎！！如果符文引擎被毁，飞空艇就无法继续飞行了！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Damn... if only I had my weapon...
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
该死……要是我有武器就好了……

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Iris!! Let's go down to the engine room! Loki and Fenrir, hold this place!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
艾莉丝！！我们去引擎室！洛基和芬里尔，守住这里！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Oh...okay! Alright... Let's go!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
哦……好的！好吧……我们走！！

scripts.text:
[Traveling Knight]
What are these things?
Should I cut them all down? ...No it is not enough money for me to be involved...
scripts.translation:
[游历的骑士]
这些是什么东西？
我要把它们全部砍倒吗？……不，为了这点钱我可不想卷入其中……

scripts.text:
[Passed out Drunkard]
Ugh... Getting drunk... hiccup
....Snore...Zzz
scripts.translation:
[醉倒的酒鬼]
唔……喝醉啦……嗝
……呼……呼……

scripts.text:
[Wealthy man at a meal]
Wha... what are these monsters?!
How dare you interrupt my precious meal time! Guard! Where are you!
scripts.translation:
[用餐的富人]
什……什么魔物？！
竟敢打扰我宝贵的用餐时间！卫兵！你们在哪！

scripts.text:
[Free Riding Bard]
Whoa... Gorgeous~ Fantastic~
Even the exploding ship is incredible~ Whoa~
scripts.translation:
[搭便车的诗人]
哇……好壮观~ 太精彩了~
连飞空艇爆炸都这么不可思议~ 哇~

scripts.text:
[Airship Cafeteria Manager]
They might look menacing but those monsters are also customers to my cafeteria.
What would you like monster customer?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇餐厅经理]
它们看起来可能很凶，但对我来说它们也是餐厅的顾客。
请问魔物顾客您想点什么？

scripts.text:
[Airship Cafeteria Manager]
Ah... Argh! Help me!!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇餐厅经理]
啊……啊！救命！！

scripts.text:
[Gambling Spirit]
Hey! Don't touch my cards!
Off with your hands and neck!
scripts.translation:
[赌博之魂]
嘿！别碰我的牌！
把你的手和脖子都给我砍下来！

scripts.text:
[Gambling Spirit]
Huh..?!
I was just getting a feel for this and these monsters show up?! Are you trying to steal my money because I won a little? Huh?!
scripts.translation:
[赌博之魂]
什……什么？！
我刚开始摸牌，这些魔物就出现了？！难道是因为我赢了一点，你们就想抢我的钱吗？哼？！

scripts.text:
[Airship Crew]
This is the entrance to the engine room. Stop them from getting in!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇船员]
这里是引擎室的入口。阻止它们进来！

scripts.text:
[Airship Crew]
Damn... There are too many of them! The engine room could get overrun!!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇船员]
该死……它们太多了！引擎室要被攻陷了！！

scripts.text:
[King's Escort]
We must not waken our sleeping King no matter what happens!
scripts.translation:
[国王的护卫]
无论发生什么，都绝不能吵醒正在熟睡的国王！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
....Snore...Zzz

[Chaos]
Damn... They have already reached this far! Thanks to you the Rune Engine was defended.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
该死……它们已经追到这里了！多亏了你，符文引擎才得以保全。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Uh...oh!! There's a gremlin heading towards the engine room!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
呃……啊！！有一只小鬼正朝引擎室跑去！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
.....!! We have to stop him!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
……！！我们必须阻止它！！

scripts.text:
[Gremlin]
Squeak..!!
- Pop! Pop pop!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Eeek!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
呀！！

scripts.text:
[Crew Member]
Argh! The Rune Engine!! The engine room has exploded!! Fire suppression team! Put out the fire!!
scripts.translation:
[船员]
啊！符文引擎！！引擎室爆炸了！！消防队！快灭火！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Damn it!! It's dangerous here! Let's get out of here first! Iris, hurry!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
该死！！这里太危险了！先撤出去！艾莉丝，快！！

scripts.text:
[Traveling Knight]
Ah.. Argh!!
It's going to explode! Have to go over... I have to go over to that Airship on the other side!!
scripts.translation:
[游历的骑士]
啊……啊！！
要爆炸了！得过去……我必须去对面那艘飞空艇！！

scripts.text:
[Free Riding Bard]
Whoa... Gorgeous~ Fantastic~
Even the exploding ship is incredible~ Whoa~
scripts.translation:
[搭便车的诗人]
哇……好壮观~ 太精彩了~
连飞空艇爆炸都这么不可思议~ 哇~

scripts.text:
[Gambling Spirit]
What is this? Fire?
Ahhhhhh~
scripts.translation:
[赌博之魂]
这是什么？火？
啊啊啊啊~

scripts.text:
[Airship Cafeteria Manager]
Is this ship.. going to fall..
However I will share fate with this ship. This ship and I are one!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇餐厅经理]
这艘船……要坠毁了吗……
无论如何，我将与这艘船共存亡。我与这艘船是一体的！

scripts.text:
[Airship Cafeteria Manager]
Ah... Argh! Help me!!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇餐厅经理]
啊……啊！救命！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
...These bastards just keep coming.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
……这群混蛋没完没了。

scripts.text:
[?????]
As expected. Our intuition wasn't wrong. It was fruitful to have followed the wave of evil and come this far.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
果然如此。我们的直觉没有错。追随邪恶的波动来到这里，真是值得。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
...?? Who goes there!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
……？？是谁在那里！！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Let me introduce...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
请允许我们自我介绍...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Shiva! Basara! Laksmi!
We are the invincible Rangers!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
湿婆！婆娑罗！拉克什米！
我们是无敌的游侠！

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
Guardian Heroines!!
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
守护女英雄！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
......

[Shiva]
Hm? What's with the reaction? Everybody is kind of a lukewarm... Was it too much?
scripts.translation:
[湿婆]
嗯？怎么这个反应？大家好像都挺冷淡的...是不是太夸张了？

scripts.text:
[Basara]
Hm, no, no. Everybody is just captivated by our great entrance.
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
嗯，不不不。大家只是被我们华丽的登场迷住了。

scripts.text:
[Laksmi]
Right, right. This much production for a hero's entrance is a bit too much!!
scripts.translation:
[拉克什米]
没错没错。作为英雄的登场，这点排场还是太少了！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Pu....
Puhahahahahahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
噗....
噗哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What? Who are these idiots?!
Just look at their clothes!!
Are those stage costumes? Are they celebrities and not heroes?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
什么？这些白痴是谁？！
看看她们穿的衣服！！
那是舞台服装吗？她们是明星而不是英雄吗？

scripts.text:
[Shiva]
Humph. You don't know what you're talking about!
Do you know how much these clothes cost? That is what's wrong with people who are dull to the latest fashion~
scripts.translation:
[湿婆]
哼。你根本不懂！
你知道这些衣服多少钱吗？这就是不懂最新时尚的人的毛病~

scripts.text:
[Basara]
You guys! This isn't the time to be chatting like this! Let's root out the wave of evil!!
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
你们！现在不是闲聊的时候！让我们铲除邪恶的波动吧！！

scripts.text:
[Shiva]
Roger, Basara! Let's end it with a swift attack!!
Huuma Metal Shuriken!! Hiyah!
scripts.translation:
[湿婆]
收到，婆娑罗！让我们用迅捷的攻击结束这一切吧！！
飞镖！！嗨呀！

scripts.text: - Pop! Pop pop!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What, what are they... Absolute morons...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
什么，她们在干什么... 绝对的白痴...

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Oh? Gee!
An unexpected ally?
This could turn out to be a fun party~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
哦？哎呀！
意想不到的盟友？
这可能会变成一场有趣的队伍~

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Wait!
It would be better to end this party now... What is this? Did Freyja send you?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
等等！
现在结束这场队伍比较好... 这是什么？是弗蕾雅派你们来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Oh. You have no fear.
How dare a mere lowly human say Freyja's name.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
哦。你竟然毫不畏惧。
区区低贱的人类，竟敢直呼弗蕾雅的名讳。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
As expected. You are Freyja's pawn?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
果然。你是弗蕾雅的棋子？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
...Careful. If you keep going on like that...
You will receive a divine punishment!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
...小心。如果你继续这样下去...
你将受到神罚！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
...!!

[Arcana]
Okay~ I will show you something good. Something to cool your heads.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
好吧~ 我会给你看点好东西。让你冷静一下。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Could it be... Wyvern's Breath?!!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
难道说...是双足飞龙的吐息？！！

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
B.I.N.G.O. ~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
宾果~

scripts.text:
[Wyvern]
Wooooo..!!
scripts.translation:
[双足飞龙]
呜哇哇哇..！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
No... no!! The ship!!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
不...不！！船！！

scripts.text: - Boom!!!

[Fenrir]
...?! Loki!!

[Loki]
Hm...
My new clothes are ruined...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
嗯...
我的新衣服弄脏了...

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Ooh.. you threw back Wyvern's Breath... an unexpected outcome. But can you withstand this one?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
哦...你竟然把双足飞龙的吐息吐了回去...真是出乎意料的结果。不过，你能承受住这一招吗？

scripts.text:
[Wyvern]
Wooooo..!!
scripts.translation:
[双足飞龙]
呜哇哇哇..！！

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Bothersome pests...
You! I will face one while you face the other...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
讨厌的小鬼...
你！我来对付一个，你去对付另一个...

scripts.text:
[Gremlins]
Squeak... Kooar~!!
scripts.translation:
[小鬼]
吱吱...库阿~！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Eek! There are still more of these!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
呀！还有这么多！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Felrock]
Found it! My weapon! Hehehehe
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
找到了！我的武器！嘿嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
I will show you what happens when you attack my ship!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
我要让你们看看攻击我的船会有什么下场！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
I will end this with my specially manufactured Exodus Joker XIII Doom Rifle!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
我要用我特制的“出埃及记”十三号末日步枪结束这一切！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Just.. just a minute...
You're really going to fire that?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
等...等一下...
你真的要开火吗？！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Of course!
Hehehehehehehehe!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
当然！
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text: - Bang! Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Gremlins]
Urrrk!!
scripts.translation:
[小鬼]
呜噜噜！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Muhahahaha!
How do you like that!!
Muhahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
穆哈哈哈哈哈哈！
感觉如何！！
穆哈哈哈哈哈哈

scripts.text: - Bang! Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Arrgh... the en..engine!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
啊...引擎...引擎！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
What?! Those bastards are breaking the engine more?!! You're making me angry!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
什么？！那群混蛋还在破坏引擎？！
你们让我很生气！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
You're the one who did it!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
明明是你自己干的！！！

scripts.text: - Bang! Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Bastards! Die! Die!
Muhahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
混蛋！去死！去死！
穆哈哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
The way things are going the ship will crash because of that reindeer captain!! Stop that captain!! I'm scared...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
照这样下去，船会因为那个驯鹿船长而坠毁的！！
快阻止那个船长！！我好害怕...

scripts.text:
[Iris]
How can we stop him? ...Maybe he will regain his senses if you beat him just enough to not die... I'm counting on you!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
我们要怎么阻止他？...也许只要把他打晕，让他恢复理智...就足够了...拜托你了！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
You get out of here now!! This ship is in danger!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
你们现在立刻离开！！
这艘船正处于危险之中！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Oops.. I was shooting like crazy. Looks like a lot of the Gremlins are gone? Hehehehe
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
哎呀...我刚才乱射了一通。
看起来很多小鬼都没了？嘿嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[Iris]
The ship is damaged because of you!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
船是因为你才受损的！！

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Doing our work for us. Hm, I guess this is enough?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
替我们做了工作。嗯，看来这样就够了？

scripts.text:
[Arcana]
Then it's time for us to slip away...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔卡纳]
那么，是时候撤退了...

scripts.text:
[Laksmi]
Oh? ... There, Basara. Looks like they are retreating.
scripts.translation:
[拉克什米]
哦？...婆娑罗，看来他们正在撤退。

scripts.text:
[Basara]
Of course!! They got a sense of our skill!! Hohoho~
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
那是当然！！他们感受到了我们的实力！！呼呼呼~

scripts.text:
[Basara]
On that note, one last Huuma Metal Shuriken!!
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
趁此机会，最后一发虎纹金属飞镖！！

scripts.text: - Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Eek!! Looks like we'll fall!!
...too short... Can't reach...
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
呀！！我们要掉下去了！！
...太短了...够不到...

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
...is this the end?
...A place I can't reach like before...
Chaos...
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
...这就是结局吗？
...像以前一样，一个我够不到的地方...
混沌...

scripts.text:
[Loki]
...Grab on
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
...抓住

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Lo...ki?
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
洛...基？

scripts.text:
[Loki]
What are you looking at? Here, come up...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
看什么看？上来，快...

scripts.text:
[Guard]
All engines confirmed halted!!
We have to quickly escape!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
所有引擎已确认停止！！
我们必须迅速撤离！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Damn...
Everybody get on the lifeboats!
Board the lifeboats with the passengers being first priority! Release the lifeboats that have completed boarding!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
该死...
所有人上救生艇！
乘客优先登艇！登满的救生艇立即放艇！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Wait!! There are still people remaining!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
等等！！还有人在上面！！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
There's nothing we can do!
If we keep stalling the rest will be in danger!! It's too bad but we have done all we can!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
我们无能为力了！
再拖延下去，剩下的人也会陷入危险！！虽然很遗憾，但我们已经尽力了！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
But the remaining people are precious lives as well! You're going to leave them?!! Huh?!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
但剩下的人也是宝贵的生命啊！你要抛弃他们吗？！什么？！

scripts.text:
[Captain Ferlock]
Yeah, you are right...
On that note I will leave you to take care of the aftermath. I'm off!!
scripts.translation:
[船长 费尔洛克]
是啊，你说得对...
既然如此，善后工作就交给你了。我走了！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Hey! Where are you going! Argh!!
I will catch you. I will kill you!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
喂！你要去哪！可恶！！
我会追上你的。我会杀了你！！

scripts.text:
[Basara]
It is not the time for us to be facing these trivial Gremlins.
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
现在不是对付这些小鬼的时候。

scripts.text:
[Basara]
I can feel a larger wave of evil.
Let's leave these little ones to them. Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[婆娑罗]
我感觉到一股更强大的邪恶气息。
把这些小家伙交给她们吧。走！

scripts.text:
[Laksmi&Shiva]
Roger!! Ranger Flying form!!
scripts.translation:
[拉克什米与湿婆]
收到！！游侠飞行形态！！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Huh? Hey!!
Where do you think you're going after destroying the ship?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
什么？喂！！
你毁了船就想跑吗？！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
If I catch you next time I will make sure you die!! Be nervous!! You got it?! Be ready, you yokels!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
下次让我抓住你，我绝对要你死！！给我小心点！！听到了吗？！乡巴佬们！！

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
...yokels? (Rage)
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
...乡巴佬？（愤怒）

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
The ones who denigrate and condemn the path of righteousness... We should mercilessly hand down righteous judgment, right?
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
诋毁并谴责正义之道的人...我们应该毫不留情地给予正义的审判，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
Die villains!! Huuma Metal Shuriken!!
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
去死吧，恶棍们！！华丽金属飞镖！！

scripts.text: - Bang! Babang! Bang!
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Eeek!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
呀！！

scripts.text:
[Guardian Heroines]
Ahahahahaha!!
Serves you right~!! Let's go!!
scripts.translation:
[守护女英雄]
啊哈哈哈哈！！
活该~！！走！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Iris!! Come here!!
Let's quickly find Fenrir and Loki and get out of here!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
艾莉丝！！过来！！
我们快去找芬里尔和洛基，然后离开这里！！

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
You get out of here now!! This ship is in danger!!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
你们现在立刻离开！！
这艘船正处于危险之中！！
